cases.name: Lucila "Lucy" Albares Lara
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Throughout her life, Lucila found joy in the simple wonders of the world around her. She had an enduring love for all things pink, plants, and the gentle songs of birdies.

Her memory will forever remain in the hearts of her family, friends, and all who had the privilege of being a part of her life."
